title: Who is Calcharo? Wuthering Waves
sources: https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com official news 710 'Profile Reveal: Phantom Hunters — Calcharo': leader of the 'Ghost Hounds', an independent multinational mercenary group; ruthless, vengeful, and unforgiving; a potential client must be mindful of the price. Key art: Leader of the Ghost Hounds; Attribute Electro; 5 stars

Official news 710 lore images: Cradle of Rumors (stories of him surviving a crusade against the entire country's cops; at the center of countless tales); Quid Pro Quo (never take an unprofitable job, though information, contacts and consensus are as valuable as money; to desperate people he offered '1 Shell Credit' with one condition: become his informers; one can never know if the lady selling snacks in the alley works for Calcharo); Overclock Diagnostic Report (extremely high risk of Overclocking, documented history); Mirage Etching (during Resonance Liberation, indigo thorns made of electric mirages wrap around his body); The Underdog's Nameplate (his childhood nameplate, rusty carvings of a dog crudely drawn by a child); A Customized Arsenal (cartoon puppy-shaped hardtacks; a special affection for puppies)

scenes.narration: He leads the Ghost Hounds, a mercenary group. Ruthless. Vengeful. Unforgiving. This is Calcharo, in Wuthering Waves.
Rumors say he once survived a crusade against an entire country's police. Today, he's at the center of countless legends.
His first rule: never take an unprofitable job. But to him, information and contacts are worth just as much as money.
Desperate people who begged for help paid him just one Shell Credit, on one condition: become his informers. Even the snack seller in the alley might work for him.
His file warns of an extremely high risk of overclocking. And in his Liberation, electric mirages wrap around him like thorns.
Yet he still carries a rusty childhood nameplate, carved with a little dog. And his base stocks puppy-shaped hardtack. He's a five-star Electro Resonator.
So, what would you pay to hire Calcharo? Tell me in the comments.
